title: Syrian Lamb Pie
description: Warm and comforting dish combining the rich flavors of Syria with the classic simplicity of a lamb pie.
instructions: In a large pan, heat the olive oil over medium-high heat. Brown the lamb shoulder on all sides, then set aside.
Add the chopped onion to the pan and cook until softened, about 5 minutes. Add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute.
Add the dissolved tomato paste, hot beef broth, salt, and black pepper to the pan. Stir to combine.
Return the lamb shoulder to the pan and bring the mixture to a boil. Cover and transfer to the preheated oven.
Bake for 2 hours, or until the lamb is tender and falling apart.
While the lamb is cooking, prepare the pie crust by mixing the flour and melted butter in a bowl until a dough forms.
Roll out the dough to a thickness of about 1/8 inch. Place the dough over the lamb and crimp the edges to seal.
Return the pie to the oven and bake for an additional 20-25 minutes, or until the crust is golden brown.
Let the pie rest for 10-15 minutes before serving.
